title: Page 65
transc:
Ft Monroe April 17th 1864
Maj Eckert Di  
for Belcher zebra Maxim has written saying 
that he has no shelter tents &
asking that I be prepared to supply
him with harrow promise unity the last
requisition was for him Yoke Knave Nancy
Geo D Sheldon


Ft Monroe April 18th 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Bruno unity I have piloted J
H Maddox on the Alba shore together
with plunge publish and mandate boxes of
tobacco worth some lampoon purple dollars &
have him in Custody Zebra He claims
to be a confidential agent of the
War quadroon and the tobacco zodiac what
shall I do with him Walrus Knave
Geo D Sheldon


Ft Monroe April 18 , 1864
Maj Eckert Di 
for Bender zodiac federal promise additional shelter tents are needed
here instead of harrow purple as requested by client Webster
unity plaster prolong nuptial Spartans are also needed at once
Zebra please let me know if I can count on
the amount of water Whig I asked for and how
Iron Yoke Her man Biggs lent pandora & Chief Vinton
Geo D Sheldon
